plastic.recommended_action: Separate clean plastic items and place them in an accepted plastic recycling collection point.
preparation: Empty the container.
Rinse off food or liquid residue.
Separate different plastic types if required by local rules.
plastic.environmental_impact: Plastic can persist in the environment and harm wildlife when improperly discarded.
plastic.safety: Do not recycle containers with unknown chemical contents without checking local guidance.
tips: Avoid mixing plastic with wet or food-contaminated waste.

paper.recommended_action: Place clean, dry paper in a paper recycling collection point.
preparation: Keep paper dry.
Remove plastic wrapping and other non-paper materials.
Check local rules for coated or laminated paper.
paper.environmental_impact: Recycling suitable paper can reduce demand for virgin materials.
paper.safety: Avoid recycling paper contaminated with oil or unsuitable substances.
tips: Keep paper separate from food waste.

cardboard.recommended_action: Flatten clean cardboard boxes and take them to an accepted paper recycling collection point.
preparation: Flatten boxes.
Remove tape and plastic packaging where practical.
Keep cardboard dry and free from food residue.
cardboard.environmental_impact: Recycling cardboard can conserve raw materials and reduce landfill waste.
cardboard.safety: Handle cutting tools and packaging staples carefully.
tips: Reuse boxes for storage or packaging.
Do not place heavily food-soiled cardboard with clean recyclables.

glass.recommended_action: Take accepted glass bottles and jars to a designated glass collection point.
preparation: Empty the container.
Rinse if required by the collection service.
Keep broken glass safely contained and follow local handling rules.
glass.environmental_impact: Suitable glass can often be recycled into new glass products.
glass.safety: Do not handle broken glass with bare hands.
tips: Do not assume mirrors, ceramics, bulbs, or window glass belong in bottle-and-jar recycling.

metal.recommended_action: Separate accepted metal cans and scrap and take them to an appropriate recycling collection point.
preparation: Empty containers.
Rinse food residue if needed.
Keep sharp edges protected.
metal.environmental_impact: Recycling suitable metals can reduce the need to extract new raw materials.
tips: Separate metal from mixed-material packaging when practical.
Use authorized handlers for large or hazardous metal items.

organic.recommended_action: Place suitable food scraps and garden waste in an approved composting or organic-waste collection system.
organic.collection_route: Organic waste collection or composting facility
preparation: Separate organic waste from plastic and other dry waste.
Remove packaging.
Follow local composting rules.
organic.environmental_impact: Composting suitable organic waste can return nutrients to the soil and reduce landfill disposal.
organic.safety: Store food waste properly to reduce pests and unpleasant odours.
tips: Use a suitable home composting system if available.
Do not add meat, dairy, or oily food unless the composting system accepts it.

electronic.recommended_action: Take discarded electronics to an authorized e-waste collection centre or an approved take-back program.
preparation: Do not place electronics in ordinary household bins.
Remove personal data from devices where possible.
Follow collection instructions for batteries included in devices.
electronic.environmental_impact: Improper disposal can release hazardous substances and waste valuable recoverable materials.
electronic.safety: Do not burn or dismantle electronic waste without suitable training.
tips: Repair or donate working devices where appropriate.

battery.recommended_action: Use an approved battery collection point or authorized battery-waste service.
battery.collection_route: Battery collection point or authorized battery recycler
preparation: Keep batteries separate from ordinary household waste.
Do not puncture, crush, or burn batteries.
For damaged or swollen batteries, follow specialist handling guidance.
battery.environmental_impact: Improperly discarded batteries can cause fires and release harmful substances.
battery.safety: Do not dismantle, crush, puncture or burn batteries. Seek professional guidance for damaged, swollen or leaking batteries.
tips: Keep batteries away from heat and metal objects.

general.recommended_action: Use the local general-waste collection service only for items that cannot be reused, recycled, or composted through available programs.
general.collection_route: Municipal general waste service, if accepted
preparation: Check whether the item can be reused or recycled first.
Keep hazardous items and electronic waste out of general waste.
Follow municipal waste-separation instructions.
general.environmental_impact: Mixed waste may increase landfill use and make recovery of recyclable materials more difficult.
general.safety: Do not assume unidentified waste, batteries or electronic waste are safe for ordinary disposal.
tips: Check local guidance for unusual or hazardous items.
